description_expanded:
Located in the recently completed Della building, this unique 2-story condominium is conveniently placed in the middle of the town center shops and restaurants. Upon entering the condo, you will find a spacious living room, dining area and kitchen with a large center island, perfect for cooking and entertaining. Also on the first floor are two bedrooms, both with one queen bed. These bedrooms are separated by a shared full bathroom. As you ascend the staircase to the 2nd floor, you will find the primary bedroom, laundry machines, outdoor patio, and primary bathroom. The primary bedroom is located in a large rotunda-style octagon featuring large windows that allow plenty of natural light. The north-facing patio is located just off of the primary bedroom and offers a relaxing space to enjoy cocktails or an early morning coffee. Separated from the primary bedroom on the 2nd floor you will find a stackable laundry next to a large walk-in closet. At the end of the hall, you will find the primary bath with a walk-in shower and double vanity. Parking for Della 102 is located in a parking court behind the building with one reserved space. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Della 102. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
